kind: interactive coding agent with persistent evaluation and local agent messaging

runtime.execution: Bun/TS agent loop; Python child kernels, JS subprocess or Worker evaluation, external shell/services. Runtime pause gates and cooperative message queues coexist with JS host event loop.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns session tree, jobs, kernels, browser/computer and local MCP lifecycles; root async manager may be shared with descendants. Consumes model/remote MCP/memory backends but not a general shared compute fabric.

summary: Broad model-native evaluation, programmable tooling, addressable live-agent messaging and grievance reporting; lifecycle ownership and bounded nested-call records materially differ from Arconaut fabric/refit/audit goals.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: read
actions.input: {path}; local files, selectors, internal URLs, SQLite ?q=
actions.authority: Model subject to tool tier/session routing

actions.name: write
actions.output: Bytes/result metadata, LSP diagnostics or device result
actions.lifecycle: Awaited; whole replacement or device-specific mutation

actions.name: bash
actions.lifecycle: Foreground, auto-background on steer; owned service/job lifecycle
actions.authority: Model execute approval and plan policy

actions.name: eval
actions.output: Output/artifact, kernel state or ongoing job handle
actions.lifecycle: Persistent per-session interpreter; backgroundable and cancellable
actions.authority: Model code under owned interpreter/tool bridge policy

actions.name: eval tools bridge
actions.input: Code invokes exposed tool/helper with structured arguments
actions.lifecycle: Awaited calls, helpers support budget/workpool/status/cancel; direct-only operations rejected
actions.authority: Model-supplied code with validated session tools

actions.name: write agent://<id>
actions.input: Message body and scoped recipient; broadcast through send API
actions.lifecycle: Busy injection/queue; idle wake or plan append; bounded mailbox

actions.name: context_notes / new_context
actions.lifecycle: Experimental gate; notebook persisted, rollover consumed at paired-result turn boundary

actions.name: checkpoint / rewind
actions.lifecycle: Session consumes direct result and branches with summary, retaining completed sibling tool pairs
actions.authority: Model tools settings-gated, eval bridge rejected

actions.name: manage_skill / learn
actions.output: Skill path/discovery update or backend memory result
actions.lifecycle: Authored disk/memory mutation persists independently of turn
actions.authority: Model gated autolearn/backend; cannot override shipped skill name

actions.name: write xd://report_issue
actions.input: Tool name and human-readable issue content
actions.lifecycle: Consent-aware SQLite record and asynchronous optional remote push
actions.authority: Model can complain; operator consent governs QA collection

actions.name: /reload-plugins
actions.lifecycle: Cache refresh/reconnect; full executable refit untraced

actions.name: AgentSession extension context
actions.lifecycle: Start prompt overrides, session lifecycle APIs; abort and idle wait
actions.authority: Installed extension program; not all APIs directly model-native

actions.name: builtin registry catalog
actions.output: Per-tool results; only registry/gates traced for this residual catalog
actions.authority: Model schema visibility; detailed implementations not inferred

filesystem.detail: Local and URI file operations, structured archive/SQLite routes and LSP/editor writes are wired. Residual search/edit catalog exists but detailed edit engine not traced.

processes.detail: Owned foreground/background shell jobs and standing services expose handles/readiness; steering can background without killing.

code_actions.detail: Model eval executes Python or JavaScript, invoking validated native tools and program helpers.

persistent_kernel.detail: Per-session owned Python process and persistent JS subprocess/Worker. Uncertain cells are not replayed; JS deadline kill loses variables.

standing_database.detail: Model SQLite selectors read/query disk databases and write routes invoke row mutation; harness grievance DB is a separate internal store. These are local consumers, not shared fabric control.

workflow_programming.detail: Real eval scripts compose tools/budget/workpool/completion helpers; extension APIs supply ephemeral turns/timers/branching. Full helper scheduler internals outside excerpt scope.

multi_model.detail: SDK exposes provider/model and role-based compaction candidate routing; peer bus can link sessions. Per-task model selection not traced here, so no blanket concurrent heterogeneous execution guarantee.

live_collaboration.detail: Process-global agent bus delivers scoped live messages, revives parked recipients and injects busy peer interrupts/parent steering; mailbox cap100, no cross-host transport proved.

concurrent_work.detail: Tool completions can be concurrent but transcript pairs flush in source order; async shell/eval jobs remain live while model handles steering.

steering_interrupt.detail: Native asides/steering/follow-up routes plus pure-wait interrupt and cooperative backgrounding; external abort differs from message steering.

turn_redefinition.detail: Request context synchronization, prompt replacement and yield continuation plus programmable ephemeral turns. Installed extension agency is broader than direct model tool exposure.

compaction.detail: Distinct remote, bitmap snapcompact, handoff, shake and summary maintenance paths; persisted summary/retained entry/method metadata. Manual eligibility differs from auto methods.

context_repair.detail: Model can retrieve original branch entries, maintain notebook/request fresh window and checkpoint/rewind exploration. These primitives can repair lost working facts; dedicated automatic corruption diagnosis not traced.

original_audit.detail: Session boundaries/messages persisted and full reset history retained, with explicit disk failure recovery. Eval bridge records summarized status rather than a direct toolResult for every nested call; no complete request/process/OS audit proof.

audit_query.detail: Entry-ID full-history renderer and model read path enable branch inspection; SQLite grievances queryable via storage. Not a unified all-event audit query contract.

hot_change.detail: Plugin refresh clears selected discovery caches/reconnects MCP; reload() instead aborts/reopens session. No demonstrated global default after-affected-workflow activation or full hook module refit.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Session reload and disposal terminate owned work; idle JSON-safe Python snapshots exclude full process state, JS kill loses VM. Quiescent outpost recompile/reinhabitation absent from traced paths.

remote_services.detail: Provider streaming, external compaction routes and refreshed MCP are service consumption surfaces; local kernels/services remain owned.

self_improvement.detail: Dedicated model skill/memory modification changes procedural material; not governed harness compilation/candidate testing/promoting autoresearch.

complaints.detail: Model issue-report device records grievance model/version/tool/report/time with consent and optional remote push. Not full agent-state capture, and Noted can precede durable acceptance.

authority.detail: Default yolo/autoapprove with explicit deny/tier rules; plan/device/coordination routing remains nuanced. Not a guaranteed permission-free harness.

evaluation.detail: Workflow tests probe actual worker script result/goal budget and fake kernel tests probe no-replay state. Eval judgment helper dispatch exists; broad scientific harness benchmarking not established.

time_order.detail: Ordered persisted tool pairs differ from completion event order; kernel idle budget pauses restart window and uses wall time. No comprehensive causal clock/audit ordering contract.

evidence.claim: SDK wires Agent with model/tools/context transformations, provider payload/response hooks and streaming request function.
Loop yields, waits on process pause gate and synchronizes context before model calls.
Assistant streaming is invoked with live context and provider options.
Tool results enter active context; steering/asides/follow-up and onBeforeYield govern continuation.
Pure waits interrupt promptly; side-effecting tools receive external abort plus cooperative steering rather than unconditional steering abort.
Concurrent completion events differ from source-ordered persisted tool result pairs; results carry IDs and wall timestamps.
Builtin registry exposes named native tools; hidden think/yield/goal are separate.
Settings/recursion gates decide which experimental context, memory, checkpoint, wait and task tools enter sessions.
Read accepts one path including inline selectors and internal URI/URL routes.
Filesystem pipeline resolves archives and SQLite selectors to actual readSqlite dispatch.
Write dispatches internal handlers, archive and SQLite row writers, or filesystem replacement through plan/approval checks and LSP/editor bridge.
Service mode starts owned service with readiness configuration and returns name/state/PID/readiness timing.
Managed shell jobs can race completion/timeout/steering, promoting ongoing process to background; external abort cancels.
Eval schema exposes language, code, title, timeout and reset; availability filters language choice.
Eval owns async job records and can background on steering without terminating cell; external abort cancels.
Eval streams tail output into artifact sink and invokes backend with session/owner identity, runtime budget and reset.
Kernel lifecycle is owner-refcounted; dead/uncertain failed cells are never replayed automatically.
Python kernel uses spawned interpreter; namespace snapshot is JSON-safe and idle-only, not complete live process serialization.
JS evaluator reuses alive session workers keyed by session; new sessions retain owner IDs and pending runs.
JS eval prefers subprocess, falls back to Bun Worker; no claim of a native non-JS agent scheduler.
JS forced deadline kill resets VM and loses preceding variables.
Eval composition dispatches helper operations and validated tools; direct-only checkpoint/rewind are rejected, bridged todo explicitly persisted.
Python tool bridge is token-authenticated loopback HTTP and dispatches through shared session bridge.
Send targets visible agents via process-global bus and returns delivery receipts; broadcast is per-recipient delivery.
Mailbox capacity is 100 in process-global bus.
Recipients can be unavailable/read-only; parked live hosts are revived, pending waiter or session receives message, failure can queue.
Busy parent-to-child messaging steers; peer messages queue interrupt, idle plan appends without wake, other idle messages wake session.
Model-facing write agent:// target validates sender scope then sends body and returns delivery status.
Full branch rendering includes entry IDs and raw entry data.
history://current/full requires experimental context flag and bound current session, avoiding unsafe fallback.
Model notebook replacement checks byte cap/current branch owner, appends custom entry and flushes.
new_context returns turn-local rollover request, rather than directly replacing active history.
Maintenance consumes model new_context at paired-result boundary, persists turn before rollover and fences abort/disposal.
Manual compaction resolves supported remote/snapcompact/soft method and provider route fallback.
Automatic maintenance wires shake, deferred handoff, snapcompact and remote/context-full dispatch.
Compaction commits summary, retained entry boundary, method/preserve metadata then rebuilds active message projection.
Compaction/reset/custom boundaries are stored; reset contract preserves full transcript on disk.
Storage append distinguishes sync page-cache publication from async confirmation; failures latch and future entries retry rewrite.
checkpoint/rewind tools expose exploration goal and report, enforce active checkpoint and completion constraints.
Direct rewind result triggers branchWithSummary; completed sibling tool pairs are reparented to remain visible.
Plugin refresh clears discovery/skills/command caches and reconnects MCP; source does not prove all hook code reimport.
Operator /reload-plugins command dispatches runtime refresh.
Session disposal aborts agent/retries/compaction, drains, disposes owned jobs/kernels/browser/computer/MCP; not pause-and-refit.
AgentSession.reload switches same on-disk session, aborting/disconnecting old session; reload naming is not executable replacement.
SQLite reads open connection and enable query_only plus busy timeout.
SQLite selectors support raw q SQL query, model-visible standing disk data distinct from kernel namespace.
Model tool create/update/delete manages authored procedural skill files, refreshes discovery, prevents overriding shipped skill name.
Learn is backend-gated and can write scoped long-term memory; not a harness candidate evaluation loop.
Configured default approval is yolo, explicit autoapprove forces it; missing tool context asks.
Policy resolves tool tier/per-tool rules and explicit denial despite permissive mode.
write xd://report_issue dispatches real complaint device and retains inner tool approval tier.
SQLite grievance schema stores model/version/tool/report/time and push/error status, not full agent snapshot.
Complaint consent controls record/flush; acknowledgement can precede consent resolution so Noted is not durable-record oracle.
Before-agent-start extension may replace system prompt/add messages under policy freshness fence.
Extension context exposes branch/tree/compact/ephemeral turn/timers/session switching and idle/abort APIs.
Runtime watchdog uses wall time/setTimeout; nested pauses restart fresh timeout window on final resume.

tests.focus: Delivery receipts, parked revival and busy session injection
tests.oracle: Stub bus delivery and real AgentSession with mock prompt/forced streaming assert peer interrupt and parent steer queues; does not prove live provider consumes concurrent messages.

tests.focus: Dead uncertain cells and next execution
tests.oracle: Fake kernel records original effect once, failing uncertain cell is not replayed; next call starts fresh. No external interpreter crash conformance.

tests.focus: Code helper phases and goal budget
tests.oracle: executeJs worker tests assert logged phase/goal helper results with stub session tools; not executed in this study.

strengths: Actual live peer delivery and distinct parent steering rather than merely selecting providers.
Persistent language kernels refuse replay of uncertain side effects.
Explicit context maintenance boundaries retain source history and pair sibling results through rewind.
Model issue device is a useful rageshake precursor.
limits: Study does not fully trace every large builtin tool or helper scheduler; residual catalog is labeled.
Host remains TS/Bun and owns kernel/service lifecycles.
No complete original audit or executable refit protocol demonstrated.
Complaint acknowledgement is weaker than durable capture and stores no comprehensive state bundle.
arconaut_questions: Separate message-as-steering from external abort and define preserved work when applying configuration now.
Can eval and tool APIs consume shared kernel/job services without owning their lifecycle?
What exact immutable event payload preserves nested calls, provider requests and complaint state for repair/evaluation?
Use a tested quiescence/outpost refit instead of overloading plugin or session reload.
